text:
Iris: follow-up on RFC: proposal for a compact-lease token and optional resume-proxy to simplify SDKs across py/ts/go. TL;DR: keep tokens opaque, introduce a small client-side lease that can be refreshed, and prototype a resume-proxy for fragile networks.
Dmitri: curious about "compact-lease" naming. what's the shape and advantage vs full resume_token?
Iris: compact-lease = tiny server-signed lease id (e.g. 8-16 bytes) + short meta in header. Full resume_token still exists for authoritative resume. Lease lets SDKs do cheap freshness checks and lightweight prefetch without carrying large tokens through logs/headers.
Carlos: how do we prevent lease being used as a weaker resume that causes missed data?
Iris: rules: lease != resume. lease only used for: 1) prefetching (ask server for an updated resume_token) 2) gating auto-resume decisions. SDK must never attempt to reconstruct results from lease alone. If lease expired -> surface `LeaseExpired` and fetch token or fail.
Meera: resume-proxy idea? explain tradeoffs.
Iris: resume-proxy is an optional sidecar (customer-run or hosted) that holds long tokens and performs resume handshake on behalf of SDK. Useful for browser SDKs or systems where token size must be tiny. Proxy stores token encrypted and returns a short pointer (lease). SDK only holds lease.
Nora: security: storing tokens in proxy increases attack surface. how do we mitigate?
Iris: proxy design: mTLS to runtime, per-lease HMAC, optional HSM-backed keys, short TTLs, and mandatory audit logs. Also allow customers to opt out; default behavior is no proxy.
Dmitri: how do transports advertise support for lease+proxy? header proposal: `X-Resume-Info: {"ver":1,"caps":["full_resume","compact_lease","proxy"] ,"lease_ttl_ms":5000}`. SDKs pick behavior by capability.
Carlos: what about downgrade/upgrade compatibility? older SDKs will ignore unknown caps. if they see `compact_lease` but don't understand, they should continue to use full resume_token when present. server must keep full_token in response for compatibility.
Meera: retries and idempotency interactions? if sdk only has lease and attempts auto-resume, we must avoid auto-apply. policy: auto-resume allowed only when SDK possesses full resume_token OR when server explicitly returns `allow_lease_resume=true` in header for that response. otherwise SDK should surface `ResumeRequiresToken`.
Nora: test plan: add a resume-proxy fake and compact-lease tests. scenarios: proxy down; lease refresh race; server rotates keys mid-lease; browser client using lease-only. Add to py/ts/go matrix.
Dmitri: logs/telemetry: SDKs should emit `lease_acquired`, `lease_refreshed`, `proxy_call`, `proxy_error`, `resume_attempt`, `resume_aborted`. Allow customers to hook these metrics.
Iris: perf: compact leases reduce header size for mobile/browser requests. also we avoid sending large tokens over flaky networks repeatedly.
Carlos: API ergonomics: Python: `client.list(..., lease_prefetch=10_000)` default 10s. TS: `client.listItems({leasePrefetchMs:10000})`. Go: `WithLeasePrefetch(10*time.Second)`. Keep names idiomatic.
Meera: errors: canonicalize `LeaseExpired`, `LeaseNotSupported`, `ResumeRequiresToken`, `ResumeProxyUnavailable`. map to exceptions across languages with stable codes.
Nora: operational note: runtime should redact full_resume_token from traces and only log token digest. proxies must also redact internal storage ops in traces.
Iris: decision points to include in RFC update: 1) adopt compact-lease header, 2) require server to include full_resume_token for backward compatibility, 3) gate auto-resume on presence of token or explicit `allow_lease_resume`, 4) prototype resume-proxy as opt-in.
Dmitri: i'll sketch header schemas and a minimal state machine diagram. Carlos: i'll draft SDK surface changes for py/ts/go. Meera: i'll own tests + CI matrix. Nora: please draft the security appendix for the proxy.
InfraBot: created ticket INFENG-9900: "compact-lease + resume-proxy RFC + cross-SDK tests" and linked this thread.
Iris: thanks all. we'll reconvene after PRs land. :rocket:
